subject: portrait

variants: Portrait de femme, dit à tort La Belle Ferronnière
summary: Portrait of a woman in the Louvre (INV 778), first recorded at Fontainebleau in 1642; the title is a later misnomer.

timeline.text: Portrait of a woman of the Milanese court. The sitter's identity is unresolved and the date rests on style.

claims.statement: The Louvre calls the title wrong ('dit à tort'); it arose from confusion with another portrait (the Louvre catalogues a separate panel, INV 786, under that name).

claims.statement: The Louvre visitor material says the sitter may have been Lucrezia Crivelli, a mistress of Ludovico Sforza; the identity is unresolved. Other identifications (e.g. Beatrice d'Este, Cecilia Gallerani) exist in the literature.
